construction: pi = P_field o Q_A with A in GL(8,2)
P_field: pi(x)=1+log_alpha(x), pi(0)=0; alpha root of x^8+x^4+x^3+x^2+1 (Conway, mask 0b00011101); LSB of x = coeff of alpha^0
A_columns_meaning: A e_i as an integer, i=0..7 (bit 0 = LSB); Q_A(z)=A z
transvection_word_meaning: A = T_1...T_k, T=(i,j): z_i <- z_i + z_j; pi <- pi o Q_T from P_field
convention: pi[a]=argmax(P[a,:]); relabelled code = G_b[:,pi] = G_b P^T; pi[a]=P_field[A a]
objective: optimum under BOTH the BEC Bhattacharyya Z-sum and Gaussian-approximation P_block at 2.5-6 dB (GA-optimal at 2.0 dB too; Z-sum alone prefers a different profile at 2.0 dB only)
optimality: EXACT optimum over the whole GL(8,2) orbit of P_field: 78,129,765 flags enumerated with the last column fixed to 1 (Singer-cycle symmetry; gl_flag_enum_sym_20260919.cpp, 37 min on 8 threads at low priority), 22,342 distinct pivot profiles.
note_d: d=4 for EVERY profile in the orbit (min popcount 4); d=3 is not excluded by dimension (k=91 <= dim RM(3,8)=93) but is unreachable by GL relabelling
